components.description: When a parent will be absent or part-time for part of a semester, the chair (with the dean's office) decides whether to relieve the person of a course; time worked is then assigned to replacement duties (other instruction, course design, advising, service), so duties are rearranged rather than reduced.
components.mechanism_note: Teaching replaced by other assigned duties for the time worked: a rearrangement, not relief (R16).

notes: Governing documents present (so the rule for records with no governing document, reader instructions §3, does not apply): the Faculty Policies and Procedures (handbook; March 2018 full text and the chapter 7 file, identical in 7.04 and 7.20) with the tenure-clock policy 7.04.H and leave of absence 7.20; UPPP 16.01 (leave policy); UW System UPG 10 (sick-leave policy, with WFMLA/FMLA coordination). So `missing` is false.

Missing governing document: the UW-Madison Family-Related (Parental) Leave Policy (UPPP 16.03), cited by UPPP 16.01 as the exception to the unit's discretion over leave, is not saved. The institutional unpaid parental leave (c1) is therefore coded from the Provost/APO brochure (revised November 2009; copy 2015) and faculty legislation II-308 (1988, 'Current Policy', citing Board of Regents Resolution #506), which agree; Regent Resolution #506 is also not saved.

No employer-paid parental leave exists in the sources: paid time after a birth comes only from the employee's own sick leave (22 days at hire, 12 days a year after 18 months, accumulating without limit) and, for 12-month appointees, vacation. A member with two years of service has roughly 22 + 6 days unless earlier balances were saved (inferred from UPPP 16.02 and UPG 10 accrual rates).

Superseded 1988 description not coded: II-308 says teaching faculty 'may use colleague coverage' to be paid without charging sick leave; UPG 10 (Regent policy December 2007) now requires that 'Teaching responsibilities not met because of an absence ... must be reported as leave, regardless of whether a qualified instructor covers', and the 2009 brochure says sick leave must be charged even if a colleague covers. The later governing text decides (source precedence).

II-308's other 1988 descriptions and recommendations (12-month leave in six-month blocks; vacation reserve; no simultaneous leave for two employed parents, recommended dropped; tenure-clock extension through the University Committee) are superseded by or consistent with the later documents: the brochure gives 12-month appointees up to one year from the birth, UPG 10 lets both parents each use six weeks under WFMLA, and FPP 7.04.H.1 (2018) sends childbirth/adoption tenure-clock requests to the provost with approval presumed. Recommendation 11 (tenure clock, adopted 1988) is implemented by FPP 7.04.H.1 (c11) and 7.04.D (c14).

12-month appointees are a group defined by appointment length: their unpaid leave (up to one year from the birth) is in c1's duration_variants; their vacation is c9 with faculty_group named. The member coded is a 9-month (academic-year) tenure-stream faculty member.

Calendar: the documents state the kind of term (semesters; 'one or two semesters (for academic year appointments)', 'term (semester or 8-week summer session)') but not its length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. The brochure's '19.5' weeks per semester is a pay-period figure for spreading sick leave, not a term length (R8 example).

Not components: bereavement, jury duty, voting, military, political-office, bone-marrow/organ-donation leaves (cannot be used for a birth); child-care centres, lactation rooms and the dependent-care reimbursement account (no leave, pay or protection).

Chain, birth parent: unpaid parental leave c1 (rest of the birth semester + the following semester, coded 2 semesters) containing her own sick leave for recovery c2 (up to 6 weeks); WFMLA medical leave c4 (2 weeks) then WFMLA family leave c3 (6 weeks, paid from own sick leave c6 within it), and FMLA c8 (12 weeks), all alongside c1 from its start; income continuation insurance c10 after sick leave ends (no length).

Chain, non-birth parent: unpaid parental leave c1 (2 semesters) from the birth, with WFMLA family leave c3 (6 weeks, own sick leave c6 within it) and FMLA c8 concurrent from its start; own sick leave for care of the mother c7 and WFMLA family-care leave c5 unlinked (no stated order).

Rule tension recorded: c1 begins 'after any paid leave has ended' (R15 would read consecutive_after the sick leave) but runs to the end of the birth semester; coded under R3b's reading for an unpaid leave for the rest of the semester (the semester as its length, containing the preceding paid sick leave), so c2 is `within` c1.
